hook: We won’t move a loan just to move it.
so_what: Already on a good rate? Ask what a switch adds, beyond the rate, before you break it.

myth: Business cash should come from a business loan.
reality: Credit against property is usually the cheapest business funding.
because: Home-secured lending is priced well below overdrafts. It can go to the business under a loan agreement, with your accountant. Want the home kept out? We respect that.

hook: For a first home, we don’t think a buyer’s agent is worth the fee.
so_what: You do the inspecting. We bring the sales data, due diligence and negotiation support.

label: investors
hook: Buying an investment with equity? How it’s set up matters for years.
sub: Three setups we like, and why.

label: investors
title: Keep the properties separate
body: We fund the deposit and costs through a separate cash-out split against your home, without tying the two properties together. That keeps you flexible when you want to sell or refinance one later.

label: investors
title: Park it in an offset
body: Releasing equity before you’ve found the property? We often set it up interest-only with the funds sitting in an offset. Until you use it, your effective repayment is zero.

label: investors
title: Redraw isn’t a savings account
body: Money in redraw has already paid down your home loan. Pulling it out to invest muddies what the loan is for. A separate split for investing is cleaner. Plan it with your accountant.

label: investors
headline: Get the structure right before you sign.
body: A 15-minute chat is enough to map out the setup.
